variants.name: 초승달 궁정
variants.detail: Distinct silhouette: a regal long relatively straight azure blade, a LARGE single open crescent structurally forming the guard beneath the blade. The crescent has a broad opalescent blue face and real open negative space around a small moon pearl, flowing curving quillons, discreet asymmetric lunar fins at the blade base. Slender tapering blade whose deep sapphire center carries delicate moon-phase engravings. Noble and composed; make the crescent extremely legible.
variants.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. A premium fantasy MMORPG TWO-HANDED SWORD design concept for the set "Twilight of the Blue Moon". Its primary feeling is noble, sacred, exquisite BLUE beauty and unmistakable lunar identity. Blue is the material itself: rich royal azure, deep ultramarine and luminous moonstone/opal with subtle pearl-blue veins. Pale-silver is only a very thin accent; no dominant grey metal and no steel weapon merely painted blue. Beautiful readable silhouette at small game size, graceful high-tier ornament, rich blue-on-blue surface craftsmanship. Strong functional blade taper to a needle sharp point with visibly thin cutting bevels, clear usable grip, balanced design.
Composition: ONE complete sword upright, point at top, grip/pommel below, front orthographic view, no perspective foreshortening, full object with generous clean margins on a tall portrait canvas. Clean very dark navy background, restrained lighting, crisp edges and highly detailed hand-painted production concept finish. All luminous detail stays in the weapon. No text, title, watermark, border, labels, extra weapons, people, scenery, particles or atmospheric glow obscuring contour.

variants.name: 쌍월의 날개
variants.detail: Distinct silhouette: a graceful double-curved two-handed blade in which two offset crescent arcs interlock around the LOWER THIRD of the sword, forming striking open negative spaces and winglike luminous azure fins. A single continuous sharp tapering main blade reaches the top. The guard blooms into two unequal long crescent wings instead of a horizontal crossbar. White-blue opal wing faces supported by deep royal blue structure. Ornate, asymmetrical, airy and aristocratic.

variants.name: 성월의 궤도
variants.detail: Distinct silhouette: an elegant narrow lance-like sword with a large OPEN celestial orbital halo integrated around the blade-root and guard. Three slender uneven lunar orbit arcs at different visible inclinations support a brilliant small blue full moon off-center. These rings are actual solid openwork structure, not a spell effect or background. The long sapphire blade rises through the halo and has an angular crescent notch on one side and star-faceted cutting edges. Refined astronomical royal instrument turned sword.

variants.name: 달빛 물결
variants.detail: Distinct silhouette: an irregular flowing S-curve greatsword, with a long subtly curved tapered blade and graceful wave-like layered blue moonstone sweeps. A broad crescent opening cut into the lower blade flows into a ONE-SIDED curving guard. Asymmetrical crescent fins swept backward like flowing silk, no symmetric straight crossguard, no round disk stuck on. Liquid moonlight craftsmanship, rich sapphire core, luminous opaline edge bands; elegant rather than savage or flame-themed.

variants.name: 월식의 왕관
variants.detail: Distinct silhouette: a noble eclipse greatsword with a strong deep-ultramarine central blade and a broad open CRESCENT CROWN at the guard, crowned by several unequally tall slender upward curved blue prongs. A large blue-white crescent surrounds a deep blue orb through physical negative space. The blade has a few long backward-swept angular lunar fins and a very long fine tapered point. Dramatic blue-white luminous edges contrasted with royal midnight-blue moonstone, dark but sacred and regal, not demonic, no black iron.
